title: 36 Hours in Seville
abstract: A place where flamenco dancers, gypsy street performers and Andalusian cowboys in wide-brimmed boleros still strut in 2,000-year-old plazas shaded by orange trees and palms.

title: 36 Hours in Stockholm
abstract: The city has recently declared itself the “Capital of Scandinavia,” and for the moment at least, none of the other style-conscious Viking superpowers is mounting much of a challenge.

title: 36 Hours in Geneva
abstract: It’s like a Swiss version of Atlanta: practically everyone passes through sooner or later, whether they want to or not. But there are plenty of reasons to stay longer.

title: 36 Hours in Bologna
abstract: For all its beloved medieval charm, Bologna has more than a few unexpected and contemporary surprises up its sleeve.

title: 36 Hours in Asheville, N.C.
abstract: This year-round resort town, tucked between the Blue Ridge and Smoky Mountains, draws a funky mix of New Agers, fleece-clad mountain bikers, antiques lovers and old-time farmers.
